refactor: extract console interaction into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move welcome output, command input, and separator handling into a dedicated Ui class. Keep command processing and task persistence in Monkey so this small extraction preserves all existing behavior while establishing the requested separation of concerns.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract task collection into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Encapsulate the task ArrayList behind TaskList while preserving the existing indexing, mutation, and persistence behavior. Monkey now coordinates a task-list abstraction instead of owning the raw collection.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command recognition and argument extraction behind a Parser collaborator. Monkey retains the existing command branches while depending on a focused parsing abstraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: make Storage an application collaborator
commitResults.messageBody: Configure Storage with an explicit file path and use one instance from Monkey for loading and saving. Preserve the existing data/duke.txt behavior while matching the extracted collaborator design.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: represent parsed commands explicitly
commitResults.messageBody: Add ParsedCommand to carry a recognized command and its arguments together. Parser now performs the complete interpretation once, reducing repeated string slicing in Monkey while preserving all existing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: encapsulate task completion mutations
commitResults.messageBody: Add mark and unmark operations to TaskList and route Monkey through them. Keep index validation, persistence, and user-facing messages unchanged while reducing direct task mutation in the coordinator.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: encapsulate task deletion
commitResults.messageBody: Add a delete operation to TaskList and route Monkey through it, completing the list mutation API while preserving task numbering, persistence, and user-facing output.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: introduce executable exit command
commitResults.messageBody: Begin the command-object stretch goal with a CommandAction abstraction and ExitCommand. Route the existing bye behavior through the new object while preserving all console output and loop behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract DeleteCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Move delete command validation, task mutation, persistence, and feedback into DeleteCommand. Parser now creates the command object, reducing command-specific work in Monkey while preserving behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract TodoCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Move todo validation, creation, persistence, and feedback into TodoCommand. Parser now constructs the command object, continuing the incremental command-object stretch design.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: extract mark and unmark commands
commitResults.messageBody: Move indexed task validation, completion-state mutation, persistence, and feedback into MarkCommand. Use one command object for both mark and unmark while preserving their distinct messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: complete supported command object extraction
commitResults.messageBody: Extract list display and deadline/event creation into command objects, then route all supported non-exit commands through Parser-created actions. Preserve existing validation, persistence, and console behavior while completing the stretch command architecture.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor: route unknown input through command objects
commitResults.messageBody: Add UnknownCommand and make Parser return an executable fallback for unsupported commands. This removes the final command-specific fallback from Monkey and completes the command-object stretch architecture without changing user-facing errors.
